_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The base rate is 0-for-55 on ±2-point moves — this is a textbook coil where HOLD with conviction is the skilled, statistically honest call; a directional guess here is a claim you see a breaker that 18 prior calls couldn't spot.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls forward Disbelief with HOLD; narrative implies upside breakout. Split on whether the coil releases up or continues compressing.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding drops below 0.005% with CVD turning positive and exchange netflow reversing below 80 — signals actual accumulation replacing hedged positioning
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with DXY breaking 102 and BTC funding turning deeply negative — forces re-rate toward Panic/Anxiety, or ETF flows collapsing below 60 with gold strength fading signals Denial cracking downward
